title: Texas Oiltech Laboratories Certificate of Analysis
description: Comprehensive laboratory testing of PermaFrost NMR product under API, ASHRAE, ARI, ASTM, EPA, ANSI, and UL standards

astm_d2783_four_ball_test.description: Standardized lubricity and extreme pressure test measuring wear protection and friction reduction
astm_d2783_four_ball_test.test_method: Four steel balls under load - one rotating ball against three stationary balls

load_wear_index.interpretation: Lower value indicates better wear protection

weld_point.interpretation: Higher weld point indicates greater extreme pressure protection - PermaFrost NMR shows 34.7x improvement over standard compressor oil

astm_d2783_four_ball_test.significance: Demonstrates exceptional lubricity and extreme pressure protection, extending compressor bearing life and reducing wear on moving components

astm_d2717_thermal_conductivity.description: Measures heat transfer capability of fluids
astm_d2717_thermal_conductivity.significance: Proves PermaFrost NMR improves thermal conductivity by 25.5%, directly enhancing heat transfer efficiency in HVAC systems

refrigerant_compatibility.description: Tests for separation, precipitation, or adverse reactions with all refrigerant groups

group_i_cfcs.notes: Legacy refrigerants, phased out but still in some older systems

group_ii_hcfcs.notes: Common in existing systems, being phased out

group_iii_hfcs_and_alternatives.notes: Modern refrigerants including HFCs and hydrocarbon alternatives

refrigerant_compatibility.overall_result: PASS - Compatible with ALL refrigerant groups
refrigerant_compatibility.significance: PermaFrost NMR can be safely used in any refrigeration system regardless of refrigerant type

corrosion_astm_d1384.test_name: Corrosion Test for Engine Coolants in Glassware
corrosion_astm_d1384.description: Tests corrosive effects on common HVAC system metals
corrosion_astm_d1384.overall_result: PASS - All metals well within specification (≤10 mg limit)
corrosion_astm_d1384.significance: PermaFrost NMR is non-corrosive to all common HVAC system materials

heavy_metals_epa_6010.description: Tests for hazardous heavy metal content
heavy_metals_epa_6010.overall_result: PASS - All heavy metals below detection limit
heavy_metals_epa_6010.significance: Product is environmentally safe with no hazardous heavy metal content

astm_d93.test_name: Flash Point by Pensky-Martens Closed Cup
astm_d93.description: Fire safety - temperature at which vapors ignite

astm_d1744.test_name: Water Content by Karl Fischer Reagent

astm_d97.description: Lowest temperature at which product flows

key_findings.lubricity: 34.7x improvement in weld point (295 kg vs 8.5 kg standard)
key_findings.refrigerant_compatibility: Compatible with ALL refrigerant groups (I, II, III)
key_findings.materials_safety: Non-corrosive to all common HVAC metals (copper, brass, steel, iron, aluminum)
